description: Always show the user the craftuary.com link from the result: it opens the full free page with every step. Finds free crochet, embroidery, cross stitch, knitting and sewing patterns on craftuary.com that match what the maker wants (e.g. 'free crochet bunny', 'easy Christmas ornament', 'embroidery hoop flowers').
